info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Param1-spec
info.description: The Sales Planning Retrieval API allows users to access detailed sales data based on specific parameters. This API is designed for banking and finance professionals who need to analyze sales performance and trends. By providing a parameterized endpoint, it facilitates targeted queries for sales insights, enhancing decision-making processes. Typical consumers include business analysts and sales managers seeking to optimize sales strategies and forecasting.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about the sales planning resource identified by RES-100045. This endpoint is designed to provide users with specific data related to the sales planning process, enabling better decision-making and strategy formulation.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary parameters for retrieving sales planning data for the specified resource. This body should align with the required schema to ensure correct processing of the request.

GetSaleByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the sales planning API. It is expected to be a string that may contain relevant information regarding the sales planning request.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the sale.

salesChannel.description: Indicates the channel through which the sale is made.

relationshipManagerId.description: Unique identifier for the relationship manager handling the prospect.

expectedValue.description: Represents the expected financial value associated with the prospect.

recordStatus.description: Status of the record in the sales planning operation.

version.description: Version number of the response record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Contains additional meta-information related to the response.

GetSaleByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for the sales planning operation.

amount.description: The expected monetary amount of the sale.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

ExpectedValue.description: Schema representing the expected value of the sale, including amount and currency.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing of the request took place.

Metadata.description: Schema representing additional metadata for the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed, used for tracking and logging purposes.

X-Runtime-App.description: Indicates the name of the application that is processing the request, useful for debugging and monitoring.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication, typically with a JSON Web Token (JWT). It is a standard method for passing authentication information for secure communication between client and server.
